title: Affine moment as an absolute moment
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $r,c,t\in\mathbb R$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. If $1+ctX(x)>0$ for every $x\in\Omega$, then the average of $(1+ctX(x))^r$ over $\Omega$ equals the average of $|1+ctX(x)|^r$.
